**Scope check**

perga has an explicit list of non-goals in CONTRIBUTING.md: inline image
protocols, a graph view, a plugin system, remote sources, macOS and Windows
support, bookmarks, a dedicated tag pane, split panes, multiple simultaneous
vaults, and telemetry. If your request is on that list, please say why it should
be reconsidered.
